events.name: Inauguration of ACE and Guest Lecture on "Back to Basics"
events.description: ACE's inauguration ceremony for the 2023-24 academic year, combined with a guest lecture. Chief guest Mr. M. Adithya, Technical Staff at ZOHO Pvt Ltd and a 2017-batch CSE alumnus, spoke on "Back to Basics" covering the importance of strong fundamentals, placement advice and interview success, followed by a badge distribution to the new office bearers and an interactive Q&A.

events.name: ACE Talks Odyssey
events.description: A brand-new two-round offline event held exclusively for first-year CSE and AI-DS students. In round one, teams brainstormed and wrote up ideas on pressing national problems; shortlisted teams then created and presented PowerPoint presentations in the final round, judged by ACE office bearers on innovation, spontaneity and articulation.
events.participants: All first-year CSE and AI-DS students participated in round 1

winners.name: Team Greenefy
winners.detail: AI&DS B — Sabaresh B, Raghul Sah V R T, Rohith S

winners.name: Team Praesidium
winners.detail: CSE A/B — Arun Vellayan Srinivasan, Arshad Ahmed J, Dharunaganesh Balamurugan Sree, Kevin Christopher, Ramanan G, R Mubashir Sheriff

events.name: QuizAce - AI Edition
events.description: An online AI-themed quiz hosted on Quizizz to close out 2023, open to all years of the CSE and AI-DS departments. Participants joined with a shared game code for a single, timed attempt and competed for a spot on the leaderboard.
events.prizes: Exciting prizes for leaderboard toppers (specific prize values not stated)
events.requirements: Single attempt only; stable internet connection required; participants had to set their name as "Name_Department_Year_Rollno"; quiz portal open 7:00-7:30 PM.

events.name: ACE Your Potential
events.description: A peer-mentoring session where accomplished final-year CSE/AI-DS students shared their placement success stories and personalized career advice with pre-final year students, followed by one-on-one interactions aimed at empowering attendees' career paths.

events.name: Code Fiesta
events.date: Phase I: 26th January 2024; Phase II: 5th February 2024
events.description: A two-phase coding contest. Phase I was an online preliminary round on HackerRank testing Data Structures & Algorithms problem-solving across easy, medium and hard questions (4 questions, 90 minutes). Top performers were shortlisted for Phase II, a live offline coding challenge held at the CSE department where finalists solved real-time problems under pressure.
events.requirements: Phase II finalists' final result included 25% of their Phase I score.

events.name: Tech Debate
events.description: A multi-round debate tournament for CS and AI students, covering technical topics such as AI ethics, ChatGPT in education, and the future of web development. The event progressed through prelims (12 teams), quarterfinals (8 teams), semifinals (4 teams) and a final (2 teams), judged on argument depth, logical reasoning, presentation and rebuttal skills.

winners.detail: J Abdul Rahman, Athithya V — II Year AD A

winners.name: Tech Masters
winners.detail: Sunil Sukumaran, Tanish M — I Year CSE C

winners.name: Team Botsot
winners.detail: Thejas Avila Y P, Varsha G R — I Year AD A

events.name: QuizAce - ML Edition
events.description: An online machine-learning-themed quiz conducted via Quizizz, open to CSE students, with a single timed attempt per participant and leaderboard-based recognition.
events.requirements: Single attempt only, stable internet connection required, quiz portal open 7:00-7:30 PM.

events.name: Game Design Online & Mentoring Session
events.description: An online workshop introducing students to the basics of game development using Unity 3D, led by ACE President Soorya B. It covered Unity fundamentals, core game-development principles (mechanics, physics, animation, scripting) and a hands-on sample-project session, followed by a week-long post-workshop challenge for participants to build their own games.
events.participants: Nearly 10 interested students from CSE & AIDS department

events.name: Womania Events
events.venue: CS Labs (Crack the Lock); Library Seminar Hall (Visual Voyage)
events.description: Two competitions held for girl students as part of Womania, ACE's flagship celebration of International Women's Day. "Crack the Lock" was a coding and puzzle-solving contest held in the CS labs, and "Visual Voyage" was an 18-team connections-style quiz spanning technical and non-technical topics, held in the library seminar hall.

winners.name: S G Shruti and S Vedhavalli
Pavithra E and A. Methika
winners.detail: CSE, II year (names reconstructed from garbled/overlapping OCR text)

winners.name: R.V. Santoshi and N. Mohana Priya

events.name: Womania - Guest Lecture on "Women in Tech"
events.description: A special guest lecture held to commemorate International Women's Day, featuring Ms. Subhiksha Devarajan, Senior Software Engineer at Gigamon, who spoke on challenges women face in the tech industry, the impact of patriarchy, and the importance of financial independence. The event concluded with a valedictory ceremony where the Womania competition winners were awarded trophies.

events.name: Interrupt'24
events.date: 15th-16th March 2024 (on-campus events); online events held between 28th February and 9th April 2024
events.venue: SVCE Campus (Function Hall, 5th Block Classrooms) plus online
events.description: Interrupt'24 was ACE's national-level technical symposium, conducted as part of the larger Technoways'24 umbrella event. It combined on-campus events — Joker Coder, Thrill Quest, AR VR Workshop and Visual Papyrus, held March 15-16, 2024 — with online events (Virtual Ideathon, Online Case Study and Visionary Quiz) that drew inter-college and, in the case of Visionary Quiz, international participation.

events.name: Joker Coder
events.description: An Interrupt'24 event combining a "Cryptic Decryption Battle," where teams of two deciphered seven encrypted words each using a unique cryptographic logic, with a "Code Sprint with a Twist," where teams solved three coding questions while swapping partners every 5 minutes amid music and distracting side-tasks.

winners.name: Yuvarani M and Banu S K
Sheegan Sri G M and S Sharvesh Guru

events.name: Thrill Quest
events.description: A live-action murder-mystery event held as part of Interrupt'24. Participants were assigned unique roles with individual backstories and had to gather clues, interact with other characters, and compete in mini-games to piece together the full story behind a fictional murder.

events.name: AR VR Workshop
events.description: A hands-on workshop on Augmented Reality and Virtual Reality using Unreal Engine, led by a certified Unreal Engine instructor as part of Interrupt'24 / Technoways. The session covered fundamental AR/VR concepts, development tools and real-world use cases, with hands-on exercises and practical demonstrations.

events.name: Visual Papyrus
events.description: A UI/UX-themed Interrupt'24 competition. A preliminary quiz on UI/UX principles shortlisted 15 teams, who then took part in a "Tech Company Acquisition Challenge" — bidding to acquire tech companies in a mock auction and designing UI/UX webpages showing how those companies would adapt across different eras of technology history.
events.participants: 15 teams shortlisted for the main round

winners.name: Kria V.B and Kavin V.B
winners.detail: Sri Sairam College of Engineering and Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering

winners.name: Nithish S, Naveen Karthick R and Vignesh S

events.name: Guest Lecture on "Triumph Tales"
events.description: A guest lecture themed "Inspiring Women," delivered by alumna Ms. Anuhya Gandavaram, Blockchain Developer at Param Networks. She spoke about influential women who broke barriers throughout history, then covered blockchain and generative AI fundamentals and their real-world applications.

events.name: Online Case Study
events.description: An online, inter-college case-study competition held as part of Interrupt'24. Teams of 1-3 members analyzed a real-world problem faced by a tech company and proposed solutions over a week-long submission window, judged on creativity, feasibility and effectiveness.

winners.name: Kush Prataap Ray
winners.detail: Christ University, Central Campus, Bangalore, Karnataka

events.name: Virtual Ideathon
events.description: An international-level ideathon hosted on Unstop as part of Interrupt'24 Online. In Round 1, undergraduate and graduate students submitted innovative ideas as PowerPoint presentations or documents; shortlisted teams then pitched live to a jury panel over Google Meet in Round 2. The event drew over 200 submissions from colleges across India.
events.participants: Over 200 submissions from various colleges across India
events.prizes: 1st Place: Rs. 1000 cash prize; 2nd Place: Rs. 500 cash prize; 3rd Place: Merit Certification

events.name: Visionary Quiz
events.description: An international-level online quiz held as part of Interrupt'24 Online events, testing knowledge across data structures, AI, ML and other tech domains. Open to programmers and tech enthusiasts worldwide, with recognition as "Ace Visionary" for top performers.
events.participants: 283 participants from different colleges across India, plus international participation from the USA, Pakistan and Nepal

winners.name: Arul Chandru
winners.detail: PSNA College of Engineering and Technology (PSNACET), Dindigul

events.name: Hackerrupt'24
events.venue: GUVI, IITM Research Park, Tharamani, Chennai
events.description: ACE's national-level 24-hour hackathon, held at Guvi Geek Network Pvt. Ltd., IITM Research Park. Teams submitted abstracts against posted problem statements; the top 15 of roughly 90+ submissions were shortlisted to compete on-site with an alumni mentoring round and two judging rounds staffed by industry professionals and alumni, followed by a valedictory ceremony.
events.participants: Over 650+ students from various colleges; ~90+ abstract submissions; top 15 teams selected for the hackathon

events.name: QuizAce - DSA Edition
events.description: An online quiz testing participants' knowledge of data structures — arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees and graphs — held to foster healthy competition among CSE/AI-DS students.

events.name: UI Redesign - ACE Design Jam
events.description: An individual UI/UX redesign competition, run on the Unstop platform, where participants used design tools such as Figma, Canva or Adobe XD to reimagine the interfaces of popular apps (Swiggy, Amazon, Netflix, Google Pay) while preserving core functionality. Entries were judged on creativity, usability, aesthetics and functionality.
events.prizes: Certificates of Recognition and Appreciation, signed by the HOD/CSE and faculty
events.requirements: Individual event; must use design software (Figma, Canva, Adobe XD, etc.); maintain core app functionality while experimenting with colors/features; submissions as pictures or PDFs

events.name: Valedictory 2023-24 & Guest Lecture on "Decoding the Potential: Large Language Models - Capabilities & Constraints"
events.description: ACE's year-end valedictory ceremony combined with a guest lecture, "Decoding the Potential: Large Language Models - Capabilities and Constraints," delivered by Mr. Sai Subramaniam G, Applied Research Scientist in GenAI at Quantiphi Analytics, Bangalore. The event also included presentation of the annual report, prize distribution to winners of the year's events, and recognition of ACE members with mementos and certificates.
